subject: Intro: Sequoia (Prod Modernization) — AWS co-sell + joint runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@amazon.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@sequoia.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@sequoia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Sequoia (Prod Modernization) — AWS co-sell + joint runbook

Hi Tom / Alice / Kevin —

Following up from our quarter planning — Sequoia is preparing a production modernization initiative and is evaluating a co-sell path with AWS + Redwood. I wanted to introduce the teams and propose a short joint "runbook" session next week to align on roles, capacity expectations, and the co-sell motion.

Goal: agree a joint timeline and a runbook we can share with Sequoia execs so procurement and architecture sign off are straightforward.

Suggested agenda (30–40 min):
- Quick intros (5 min)
- Current state & success metrics (Alice, 5 min)
- Proposed reference architecture + capacity ask (Redwood / Ben, 8 min)
- AWS co-sell enablement & partner motion (Tom, 8 min)
- Next steps / owners / timeline (Marissa, 5 min)

Would you (Tom) be able to include an AWS SA on the call? We can run the session as a working meeting and iterate on the runbook live. Attached is a short draft runbook and a proposed timeline to start from.

Attachments: [attachment: runbook-draft.md (8 KB)]

Thanks — happy to adjust.

— Jordan Blake
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@amazon.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@sequoia.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@sequoia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Sequoia (Prod Modernization) — AWS co-sell + joint runbook

Thanks Jordan — happy to help and I will join. I added Priya Singh (AWS Solutions Architect) to loop in the technical implementation perspective.

Jan 13 at 10:00 PT works for me; if that suits the Sequoia team we can lock it in. I'll also bring the AWS co-sell checklist so we can call out any missing procurement items.

Quick ask for the meeting: can you add a short note (1–2 bullets) on expected peak concurrent sessions and retention requirements so Priya can size instances preliminarily? If you prefer we can surface that in the first 5 minutes of the call.

Sharing an AWS co-sell enablement doc here: https://aws.amazon.com/partners/cosell-guide (quick reference)

— Tom Briggs
Partner Development Manager, AWS

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@sequoia.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@amazon.com>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@sequoia.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Sequoia (Prod Modernization) — AWS co-sell + joint runbook

Thanks for the intro, Jordan and Tom. Jan 13 at 10:00 PT works for our team.

For pre-read: attaching a one-page current-state diagram and a short note on peak traffic expectations. High-level:
- Current QPS: ~120 during batch windows; typical steady-state QPS ~15
- Retention: 30 days of retrievable logs, 12 months of archived data (cold)

We'll expect Redwood to propose an initial throughput profile + rough cost bandwidth for Dedicated vs Hosted options so our procurement team can evaluate.

Attachments: [attachment: Sequoia_current_architecture.pdf (190 KB)]

— Alice Chen
Director of Platform Engineering | Sequoia Financial
alice.chen@sequoia.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@sequoia.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@sequoia.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@amazon.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Sequoia (Prod Modernization) — AWS co-sell + joint runbook

Great — confirmed Jan 13, 10:00–10:40 PT (Google Meet invite to follow).

Quick pre-read / notes for the meeting:
- Redwood will present a baseline throughput profile and two cost-informed variants: Hosted API baseline (lower ops) and Dedicated GPU pool (predictable throughput + isolation).
- We will bring an initial recommended quantization / caching profile to show cost delta.
- Deliverables: shared runbook draft, action owners, and a 4-week pilot plan.

Attendees (proposed):
- Sequoia: Alice Chen, Kevin Liu
- AWS: Tom Briggs, Priya Singh
- Redwood: Jordan Blake, Marissa Cole, Ben Carter, Karthik Iyer

Action items before meeting:
- Ben: prepare initial capacity slide (concurrency / memory / egress) — attach to runbook by EOD 12 Jan.
- Marissa: create HubSpot opportunity and add procurement contacts (HS-12345).
- Karthik: draft Dedicated vs Hosted pricing delta table.

I've attached an updated roadmap slide deck with the pilot milestones.

Attachments: [attachment: Sequoia_Joint_Roadmap.pdf (120 KB)]

See you Wednesday.

— Jordan Blake
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]
